metaDescription: CPT 99426 explained: Principal Care Management with 30 minutes of clinical staff time. Eligibility, documentation, 2026 rate and billing rules.
summary: Monthly management of one serious condition delivered by clinical staff under the practitioner's direction, starting at 30 minutes.
time: 30 minutes of clinical staff time per calendar month
performer: Clinical staff under the billing practitioner's direction
requirements: One complex chronic condition expected to last at least 3 months, with significant risk of decline
A disease-specific care plan on file
An initiating visit for new patients, or patients not seen within the past year, to explain PCM and get consent
Documented consent and a staff time log reaching 30 minutes
pitfalls: Billing 99426 alongside CCM for the same patient and month
conflicts: Not reported with CCM for the same patient and month by the same practitioner, and not in the same month as the physician-time PCM codes 99424 and 99425.

faqs.question: What is the minimum time for CPT 99426?
faqs.answer: Thirty minutes of clinical staff time in the calendar month. Under 30 minutes is not reportable.

faqs.question: Who performs the time for 99426?
faqs.answer: Clinical staff under the practitioner's direction. This is the code Zenith's staff time supports, with your practice as the billing provider.
